data.fund_name: Aditya Birla Sun Life Dynamic Asset Allocation Omni FOF
data.fund_type:
An open ended fund of funds scheme investing in a portfolio of equity oriented and 
debt oriented mutual fund schemes.
data.investment_objective:
The Scheme aims to generate returns by investing in portfolio of equity and debt 
schemes (including ETFs and Index Funds) as per the risk-return profile of 
investors. The Scheme has a strategic asset allocation which is based on satisfying 
the needs to a dynamic risk-return profile of investors. The Scheme does not 
guarantee/indicate any returns. There is no assurance or guarantee that the 
investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation:
Under normal circumstances, the asset allocation is as follows:
Active and Passive Equity Oriented Mutual Fund Schemes- 0-100 % , Active and 
Passive Debt Oriented Mutual Fund Schemes -0-100 % 
Cash, Money Market & Debt instrumentss- 0- 5 %.
data.exit_load:
For redemption/switch out of units within 365 days from the date of allotment: 
1.00% of applicable NAV. For redemption/switch out of units after 365 days from 
the date of allotment: Nil
